status_summary: No action reviving the comprehensive account reporting proposal was found. Public Law 119-21, approved 2025-07-04, lists Section 70432, repealing the 2021 revision to the de minimis rules for third party network transactions, and Section 70433, raising the payee information reporting threshold. The IRS stated on 2025-10-23 that the law retroactively reinstated the earlier Form 1099-K threshold of more than $20,000 and more than 200 transactions, and Section 70433 amends the payee reporting threshold in the tax code from $600 to $2,000 for payments made after 2025-12-31, with cost-of-living indexing for calendar years after 2026, as shown in the U.S. Code amendment notes. These reduce specific reporting burdens; no broader review of the information reporting regime was found.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 was approved; its table of contents lists Section 70432 on third party network transaction reporting and Section 70433 raising the payee information reporting threshold.
The IRS issued FAQs (IR-2025-107) stating the law retroactively reinstated the Form 1099-K threshold of more than $20,000 and more than 200 transactions.

title: Oppose comprehensive $600 bank account reporting and cut information reporting burdens
uncertainties: The Form 1099-K threshold that the law restored was set by a 2021 statute and is distinct from the account reporting proposal the Mandate opposes; the Mandate mentions Form 1099-K only as part of that proposal, so the threshold changes are treated as partial progress on the burden-reduction item. The govinfo.gov HTML of Public Law 119-21 is cut off before Title VII, so sections 70432 and 70433 were confirmed there only by table of contents titles; the $2,000 threshold, its effective date and indexing come from the Cornell LII U.S. Code text and amendment notes for 26 U.S.C. 6041. The text of section 70432 was not read. The form-level effect on Forms 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC rests on a trade publication and was not verified on irs.gov. Whether any later budget request revived the account reporting proposal was not searched.
